{{Quote|Muuns are cowards, the lot of them. They use credits as weapons.|PePe Rossh|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
'''PePe Rossh''' was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] crew member of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Woebegone]]'' in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he and the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] other crew members departed the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. However, on course to their next stop, the Kaleesh and the rest of the crew were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], who had [[Massacre on the Woebegone|stowed away]] upon the ship to get off the planet unnoticed.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Then maybe we take him to Ithor. If he proves to be a cooperative passenger, we could consider taking him all the way to Muunilinst.|Rossh|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
[[File:KaleeshKolkpravisWarriors-GAW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Members of the Kaleesh species, which PePe Rossh belonged to.]]
A [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]], PePe Rossh was a crew member under the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ellin Lah]] on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Woebegone]]'' in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]]. Along with the rest of the crew, Rossh frequented places such as [[Vestral]], [[Sikkem IV]], [[Carlix's Folly]], and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], after coming from the world of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] picked up a cargo of fresh [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] life on Bal'demnic. After boarding the ship for departure to the planet [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], Rossh, along with crew members [[Doo Zuto]] and [[Wandau]], checked that the cargo had been stored. As the ''Woebegone'' was in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] en route to their next destination, the crew discovered that they had picked up a stowaway in one of its cargo bays. Rossh and members of the crew confronted the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] stowaway, who, although he would not give his name, was in secret the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].<ref name="Darth P" />

At the Muun's request, Lah spoke with him in private. Upon her return, Lah informed the crew that the Muun was looking to travel unnoticed to the Muun [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], which was close to Ithor. Rossh and the crew members discussed what action they should take, with the Kaleesh inclined to take the stowaway to his destination, or even use him as a hostage, as most Muuns were quite wealthy and associated with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]&mdash;even though the crew were not criminals, the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that could be gained from that would help them greatly. However, another decision was reached: the ''Woebegone'' would drop out of hyperspace and [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] the authorities on Bal'demnic to confirm if the Muun was a fugitive, as transporting a fugitive would damage their reputation. If he was, then the freighter would go back to Bal'demnic; if not, then the crew would take him to Ithor. Lah then went to inform the Muun of their decision.<ref name="Darth P" />

As the stowaway did not wish to be noticed leaving Bal'demnic, he rejected the deal and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Lah. Just as the freighter came out of hyperspace, the Muun [[Force speed/Legends|rushed]] with an activated [[Darth Plagueis's lightsaber|lightsaber]] in his [[Limb/Legends|hand]] into the cabin where Rossh, Wandau, Zuto, and first mate [[Maa Kaap]] were. Allowing Rossh and the others just enough time to draw their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], the stowaway attacked. Aided by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Blir']] and the [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] [[Semasalli]], who arrived shortly after, the crew members attempted to take out the Muun. However, after Blir', Semasalli, Wandau, and Kaap were felled by the stowaway, Rossh was [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] as he and Zuto tried to [[Unarmed combat/Legends|attack]] the Muun assailant with their hands after blasters proved ineffective. In the end, all of the crew save the ship's [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]], [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]], were killed.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|These Banking Clan types hold on to every credit. But we've got ourselves a live Muun, and no matter who he is or what he's pretending to be, I guarantee you he's worth more than ten years of dealing in meattails or octopods.|Rossh, during the discussion|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
Rossh was a scarlet-[[Color/Legends|colored]] scaly-skinned Kaleesh with a tusked face who emitted potent [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]]. During the discussion on what to do with the stowaway, Rossh favored taking the Muun to Ithor and perhaps all the way to Muunilinst. The Kaleesh considered the stowaway worth far more than ten years of cargo and also liked the idea of taking him hostage. He also thought that all Muuns were cowards and would not fight.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|We take your meaning, Captain. No inopportune omissions&mdash;''"<br />"''Ineradicable errors.|Maa Kaap and Rossh, to Captain Lah|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
Rossh was capable with a blaster and in unarmed combat and utilized his teeth and claws while fighting. Despite his skill, Rossh was killed quickly by Plagueis after attacking the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="Darth P" />

==Equipment==
Rossh wielded a blaster.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
PePe Rossh appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth P" />
